entry.title: New: dsh-llm-proxy
entry.summary: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page. Exact install spec: @superfish058/dsh-llm-proxy. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
